scientific_integrity: Berger--Block--Löwe are credited for the S4.2 theorem and independent controls; Saveliev--Shapirovsky are credited for the modal/downward-Löwenheim--Skolem context. The retained contribution is the exact-cardinality-layer theorem and its proof by cardinal-correcting each control extension. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is only for infinite cardinalities and subgroup accessibility in abelian groups. The cardinal-correction argument preserves the cited first-order controls, not arbitrary non-first-order properties. The exact day-level public release date of Berger's 2018 Master's thesis was not located.
title: S4.2 already holds on every fixed infinite-cardinality layer of abelian groups
